_README: BACKFILLED profiles for the 45 accepted modules that predate the PROBLEM_PROFILE
requirement and therefore declare no core, domain or object regime.
PROVENANCE: these were read off each module's render() output and NOTES docstring
and classified by hand. They are NOT self-declared by the builder, and they must
stay distinguishable from declared profiles -- corpus_report.py records provenance
per module for exactly this reason. Treat them as a third tier:
WHY THIS EXISTS: scripts/corpus_report.py derive_core() can only ever return a
DISCRETE core -- 'nothing about a dict of instance keys is evidence that a family
is analytic'. So before this file the older cohort showed 0% non-discrete and 16
'unknown', which was an artefact of the method rather than a measurement.
Vocabulary matches the 55 self-declaring modules exactly.
